messages:
dana: Heads up — EdgeOptics flagged a double charge on their March reserved capacity. They say they were billed twice for the same slot. Asking for a manual adjustment + refund. Screenshot attached by vendor in thread below.
ajay: Can you drop the invoice id and the erroneous line items? I can pull logs if needed.
dana: Invoice INV-2026-0321-889. Line items: \n  - RESERVED-GPU-POOL (Mar 1-31) qty 1 unit price $6,225.00\n  - RESERVED-GPU-POOL (Mar 1-31) qty 1 unit price $6,225.00\nVendor claims they should only have single line. They included a screenshot from their billing portal and our raw usage shows duplicate submission at 2026-03-20 02:14 UTC.
edgeoptics-support: Confirming. We saw the duplicate POST from our side — but the customer portal shows one subscription. They want a refund for the duplicate $6,225 charge. Sorry for the noise, working on our end.
lucy: OK. If it's duplicate usage generated by our ingestion job we should credit it. Suggested workflow: create a credit memo for $6,195.00 (minus prorated adjustments?) — wait, confirm exact refundable amount. dana can you confirm taxable/fee lines?
dana: Breakdown from the invoice: subtotal $12,450.00, tax $0, discounts $0, total $12,450.00. Refund requested: full $6,225.00 (the duplicate line). No separate fees. I'll confirm with accounting but seems straightforward.
finance-bot: Billing ledger note: customer edgeoptics (cust_4E9K) — invoice INV-2026-0321-889 posted 2026-03-21T10:05:32Z. Current status: paid. Refunds > $5,000 require manager + legal ack per policy FIN-REF-3.
maria: Ping — I'm looped. I need a short justification to approve a goodwill credit >$5k. Also need to confirm whether this was platform bug (we'll handle) vs vendor re-submitting (they should rectify). If platform bug, we file incident and root cause; if vendor fault, we can still issue a one-time goodwill credit but mark as non-precedent.
sanjay: Account manager here — customer is strategic, small ARR but high visibility. They flagged this to our sales contact; they'd like us to proceed with the refund quickly. EdgeOptics will send a short note committing to fix on their side.
ajay: Vendor provided logs showing duplicate POST at 2026-03-20T02:14:05Z and again at 02:14:05. Looks like our ingestion accepted both. Investigating idempotency keys now.
lucy: To move forward operationally, I'll need to create a credit memo and then issue a refund. Command I use in billing-tool: \n```\nbilling-tool credit-create --customer cust_4E9K --invoice INV-2026-0321-889 --amount 6225.00 --currency USD --reason \"Duplicate reserved capacity charge (Mar)\" --gl-code REV-ADJ\nbilling-tool refund-issue --customer cust_4E9K --amount 6225.00 --method stripe --note \"Goodwill/duplicate charge reversal\"\n```\n(Replace amount with final approved number) :floppy_disk:
dana: Maria, formally requesting approval to apply a $6,225.00 goodwill credit and refund to EdgeOptics. Root cause likely our ingestion accepted duplicate event; engineering investigating. We will notify legal and the customer.
maria: I approve the goodwill credit of $6,225.00 contingent on: 1) engineering ownership to file an incident and mitigation timeline, 2) sales (sanjay) gets a customer commit from vendor in writing, 3) legal ack that this is a one-off. I'll cc legal after you confirm incident id.
ajay: Filed ENG-INC-2026-082 for idempotency check — assigned to eng-runtime. ETA initial triage 4 hours.
sanjay: I'll get the customer to send a note this afternoon and paste here.
dana: Proceeding with credit-create + refund once legal confirms. I'll run the commands and post txn id. Leaving a short customer note draft: \"We’ve issued a $6,225.00 reversal for the duplicate reserved-capacity charge on INV-2026-0321-889. Our team is investigating the ingestion path that allowed the duplicate; we'll follow up with timeline.\"
finance-bot: Refund queued: txn_refund_7f9b21 posted to ledger; pending settlement. (automated)
maria: Legal (cc) — please confirm one-off waiver ok. If so, dana proceed.
edgeoptics-support: Thank you — we’ll send the note to Sanjay and follow up on our integration fix.
dana: Done. Credit memo created and refund queued (txn_refund_7f9b21). I'll follow up tomorrow with settlement status and link to ENG-INC-2026-082. Thanks team :thumbsup:
